list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY build_version

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT build_version, JSONExtractString(properties,'policy') AS policy, JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') AS outcome, count() AS simulations, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'turns')) AS turns, avg(JSONExtractInt(properties,'duration_ms')) AS duration_ms FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed') GROUP BY build_version, policy, outcome LIMIT 1000

SELECT run_id, JSONExtractInt(properties,'seed') AS seed, JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') AS outcome FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed' AND JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') NOT IN ('win','loss','aborted','replay_complete')) GROUP BY run_id, seed, outcome LIMIT 1000

SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'card_name') AS card, count() AS plays FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=${build_version:sqlstring} AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='card_played') GROUP BY card LIMIT 1000
